commit_scope: Publish retiring deployment carrier files atomically so an overlapping sync preserves an executing file's inode.
evidence_refs: The repaired native build completed in 582.5s and published source identity c835bb8d8cee24f8; the final API image was built.
The executing carrier then reported line 993: syntax error near unexpected token ')'. The file itself passes bash -n and its SHA-256 matches tracked source.
GitHub run 39131333776 synced the file at 13:23:51 UTC during that build, before cancellation. Direct SCP overwrote the inode Bash was still reading.
SCP now stages .incoming files and the SSH carrier renames them into place. This changes only OS file publication; application implementation remains Form/BML and fkwu/JIT source is unchanged.

local_validation.summary: Correlated carrier mtime, exact checksum, syntax read and runner sync timestamps; inspected atomic publication configuration.

ci_validation.summary: The production rollout observes the corrected transfer operation.

phase_gate.blocked_reason: Authorized production rollout follows source publication.
